name.ja: ジョインテック・カタパルト

requirement.en: When your opponent Normal or Special Summons a monster, place 1 face-up EARTH Attribute Machine Type monster from your field on the bottom of the owner's Deck.

effect.en: Destroy 1 face-up Level 8 or lower monster on your opponent's field. Then, if you placed a Fusion Monster to meet the requirement, you can place 1 card from your opponent's field on the bottom of the owner's Deck.
